users_location.en: U01, U02, U05; Spine and AI Origin

baseline.zh: 真实遗存、时间线、纸质地图和人工讲解
baseline.en: Authentic remains, a timeline, printed maps, and human interpretation

enhancement.zh: 多语种、无障碍和个性化解释；来源可见，生成内容不得替代史实审核。
enhancement.en: Multilingual, accessible, and personalized interpretation; sources stay visible and generated content cannot replace historical review.

task.zh: 让不同年龄的访客读懂记忆与来源
task.en: Help visitors understand memory and its sources

location.zh: 主脉解释点 / AI 原点

space.zh: 解释设施、纸质图谱、人工讲解与停留
space.en: Interpretation station, paper maps, human guide and resting

responsibility.zh: 遗产解释责任者审核史实；有误则撤下生成内容
responsibility.en: Heritage interpreter checks facts; remove incorrect generated content

users_location.en: U01, U04, U06; Spine and Everyday-Life Seam

baseline.zh: 连续路标、安静绕行、座椅和遮荫
baseline.en: Continuous signs, a quiet alternative route, seating, and shade

enhancement.zh: 按噪声、拥挤和感官偏好建议路线；可关闭定位并改用固定地图。
enhancement.en: Suggest routes by noise, crowding, and sensory preference; users can disable location and use a fixed map.

task.zh: 在通勤主路之外找到安静选择
task.en: Find a quiet alternative to the commuter route

location.zh: 主脉 / 生活缝安静院

space.zh: 平行绕行、树荫座椅与明确再汇合点
space.en: Parallel detour, shaded seats and a clear rejoining point

responsibility.zh: 运营者巡查噪声和路线；状态不明时显示待核
responsibility.en: Operator checks noise and route; show unverified states explicitly

users_location.en: All users; Spine and Three Commons

baseline.zh: 遮荫避雨、饮水、休息点和季节维护
baseline.en: Shade, rain cover, drinking water, rest points, and seasonal maintenance

enhancement.zh: 结合微气候提示舒适路线；设备故障时由固定标识和人工巡查接管。
enhancement.en: Suggest comfortable routes using microclimate information; fixed signs and human inspection take over when equipment fails.

task.zh: 夏季避热、冬季避风并能休息
task.en: Rest in summer shade and winter shelter

space.zh: 遮荫、避风、饮水与路径外停留
space.en: Shade, wind shelter, seasonal water and off-route rest

responsibility.zh: 物业确认天气与维护状态；故障用固定标识和巡查
responsibility.en: Manager confirms weather and maintenance; faults revert to signs and inspection

users_location.en: U01, U06; six stitches and Two Gates

baseline.zh: 坡道、触觉、高对比、连续休息和人工协助
baseline.en: Ramps, tactile and high-contrast information, continuous rest, and human assistance

enhancement.zh: 辅助识别障碍并建议可达路线；不得把预测结果写成已验证无障碍。
enhancement.en: Help detect obstacles and suggest accessible routes; prediction must not be presented as verified accessibility.

task.zh: 从到达点持续走到服务入口
task.en: Travel continuously from arrival to service

space.zh: 同层入口、连续引导、路径外休息
space.en: Flush threshold, continuous guidance and off-route rest

responsibility.zh: 专业与使用者复核可达；未核验不承诺无障碍
responsibility.en: Professionals and users verify access; no accessibility promise before checking

users_location.en: U01, U04, U06; stations and Dazhongsi

baseline.zh: 标准地图、班次信息、人工问询和多种路径
baseline.en: Standard maps, service times, staffed information, and route options

enhancement.zh: 展示步行、等待、绕行与照护成本；用户可选择最快、最稳或少换乘。
enhancement.en: Show walking, waiting, detour, and care costs; users may choose fastest, most reliable, or least-transfer routes.

task.zh: 比较速度、稳定性和照护成本
task.en: Compare speed, reliability and care burden

location.zh: 站点 / 大钟寺到达界面

space.zh: 实体地图、人工问询与多路径选择
space.en: Physical map, staffed help and multiple route choices

responsibility.zh: 交通运营者核对时刻与路线；过期信息退出推荐
responsibility.en: Transport operator checks timetables/routes; stale data leaves recommendations

users_location.zh: U07 与全部使用者；主脉和三园
users_location.en: U07 and all users; Spine and Three Commons

baseline.zh: 巡查表、保洁报修、公告和人工热线
baseline.en: Inspection sheets, cleaning and repair requests, notices, and a staffed hotline

enhancement.zh: 聚合设施状态和工单，异常由人工确认；不采用默认人脸识别。
enhancement.en: Aggregate facility status and work orders, with human confirmation of exceptions; no default facial recognition.

task.zh: 发现故障后知道谁处理
task.en: Know who handles a reported fault

location.zh: 主脉 / 三园维护接口

space.zh: 巡查、纸质工单、热线与公示位置
space.en: Inspection, paper job cards, hotline and notice point

responsibility.zh: 物业人工确认和派单；公开聚合状态而非个人
responsibility.en: Manager confirms and assigns jobs; publish aggregate status, not identities

users_location.en: U02, U03, U07; Zhongzhiyuan and river links

baseline.zh: 雨水标尺、植物说明、人工监测和疏散规则
baseline.en: Rain gauges, planting information, human monitoring, and evacuation rules

enhancement.zh: 辅助观察积水、热和植物状态；模型只支持维护判断，不替代工程结论。
enhancement.en: Assist observation of ponding, heat, and plant condition; models support maintenance judgement but do not replace engineering conclusions.

task.zh: 观察水绿变化并识别模型限制
task.en: Observe landscape change and model limits

location.zh: 众智园 / 水绿观察接口

space.zh: 标尺、植物说明、观察点与安全边界
space.en: Gauge, plant notes, observation point and safety edge

responsibility.zh: 专业维护者核验异常；模型不替代防汛或工程判断
responsibility.en: Professional caretaker verifies alerts; model does not replace flood/engineering decisions

users_location.en: U01, U02, U06, U07; AI Origin courtyards

baseline.zh: 线下会议、纸质意见、人工主持和公开纪要
baseline.en: In-person meetings, paper comments, human facilitation, and public minutes

enhancement.zh: 协助归纳而不代替表决；公开纠错、申诉、删除和版本记录。
enhancement.en: Assist synthesis without replacing voting; provide correction, appeal, deletion, and version records.

task.zh: 让不同意见进入同一张地图
task.en: Bring different views onto one shared map

space.zh: 圆桌、纸质地图、纪要板与室内备用空间
space.en: Round table, paper map, minutes board and indoor fallback

responsibility.zh: 人工主持与记录；参与者纠错，AI 不代替表决
responsibility.en: Human facilitation and records; participants correct, AI never replaces voting

users_location.en: U03, U07, and the public; Zhongzhiyuan

baseline.zh: 现场公告、纸质申请、人工安全说明
baseline.en: On-site notices, paper applications, and human safety briefings

enhancement.zh: 匹配时段和能力、公开风险与结果；拒绝数据不影响线下申请。
enhancement.en: Match time and capability and disclose risk and results; refusal of data does not affect offline application.

task.zh: 看懂测试规则，再申请参与

location.zh: 众智园观察廊 / 测试入口

space.zh: 围界、观察路径、纸质申请与值守点
space.en: Enclosure, observation path, paper application and staffed post

responsibility.zh: 测试负责人准入与停机；公众与测试轨迹分离
responsibility.en: Test lead controls admission and stopping; separate public route from test trajectories

baseline.zh: 普通菜单、现金／常规结账、人工咨询和明确价格
baseline.en: Ordinary menus, cash and standard checkout, staffed advice, and clear prices

enhancement.zh: 解释推荐、过敏和商业关系；一键关闭个性化，不以画像抬价。
enhancement.en: Explain recommendations, allergens, and commercial relationships; personalization can be disabled and must not enable profile-based price discrimination.

task.zh: 能获得解释，也能普通结账
task.en: Obtain explanations or use ordinary checkout

space.zh: 纸质菜单、人工柜台、可选终端与免费座椅
space.en: Paper menu, staffed counter, optional terminal and free seating

responsibility.zh: 商户核对价格和过敏信息；随时关闭推荐
responsibility.en: Merchant checks prices/allergens; recommendations can be disabled

users_location.zh: U03、U07 与社区；AI 原点两门
users_location.en: U03, U07, and communities; AI Origin Two Gates

baseline.zh: 服务目录、固定开放时间和人工转介
baseline.en: Service directories, fixed opening hours, and human referrals

enhancement.zh: 辅助匹配空间、导师与专业服务；不承诺结果，敏感申请由人工受理。
enhancement.en: Assist matching with spaces, mentors, and professional services; make no outcome promise and route sensitive requests to people.

task.zh: 带着问题找到可协商的资源
task.en: Bring a question to negotiable resources

location.zh: AI 原点两门资源接口

space.zh: 实体目录、低柜台、人工转介与等待座椅
space.en: Physical directory, low counter, human referral and waiting seats

responsibility.zh: 资源提供者维护时段和权限；不保证匹配或结果
responsibility.en: Providers maintain hours/permissions; no guaranteed match or outcome

users_location.zh: 全部用户；三园与总体门户
users_location.en: All users; Three Commons and overall gateways

baseline.zh: 定期公示、纸质报告、听证和投诉渠道
baseline.en: Periodic disclosure, printed reports, hearings, and complaint channels

enhancement.zh: 只显示聚合指标、来源和不确定性；不得公开个人轨迹或用总分掩盖权衡。
enhancement.en: Display only aggregate metrics, sources, and uncertainty; never reveal individual traces or hide trade-offs in a total score.

task.zh: 看见改善、负担与未确定的部分

location.zh: 三园 / 总体信息门户

space.zh: 纸质公示、四簿并列、投诉与版本记录
space.en: Paper notices, four parallel ledgers, appeals and versions

responsibility.zh: 运营者与独立复核者确认数据；只公开聚合结果
responsibility.en: Operator and independent reviewer verify data; aggregate results only
